note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor who authored neither 08fe903803 nor the uncommitted phase 2 of spec-single-owner-lifecycle-2-bgp-session. RFC 4724 Section 4.1 read: "Once the initial update is complete for an address family (including the case that there is no routing update to send), the End-of-RIB marker MUST be sent." Unit read: TestRFC4724EndOfRIBSentOnceTheInitialUpdateIsComplete (both tags); only its two sync calls changed. 08fe903803 moved the initial-sync gate (sendingInitialRoutes) and the End-of-RIB owed mark (initialSyncEOROwed) from Peer onto Session. In the tagged units named stale it replaced peer.sendInitialRoutes() with peer.runInitialSyncNow(), which is Peer.sendInitialRoutes(p.testInitialSync()) (initial_sync_helpers_test.go): the same production sync body, run on the session the fixture installed (or one built with NewSession(p.settings) and published through establishedSession as enterEstablished does); it replaced peer.<flag>.Store(v) with peer.testInitialSync().<flag>.Store(v) or setTestInitialSync, and drainAndCloseQueueGate now takes that session. git diff 08fe903803^ against the working tree shows no assertion, expected byte, driven input or tag prose changed in any of them, each under the RFC-approved line 08fe903803 carries. Questions 1, 3 and 4 answer exactly as the earlier judgement below; question 2 still rests on the same producers, whose discrimination records are retaken by ./le rfc record after this stamp. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. New unit TestRFC4724EndOfRIBSentOnceTheInitialUpdateIsComplete drives peer.sendInitialRoutes on an established peer and reads the socket. Positive: empty table -> the wire is exactly the IPv4 unicast EoR (the RFC's "including the case that there is no routing update to send"); with default-originate -> [UPDATE 0.0.0.0/0, EoR], EORSent 1. Negative: no EoR precedes the route and exactly one follows it (a marker before completion violates "Once the initial update is complete"). Observed-red records +/- (revert peer_initial_sync.go::sendEORFamilies); both polarities share one break, which reddens the unit as a whole rather than the ordering clause alone. Message-level EoR encoding units stay as supplementary.
